changes: Renamed Quick Mod Assign. Hold LFO and turn a knob: that parameter becomes the sound's LFO destination at depth 0, and further turns of the same knob set the LFO's depth with stock's DEP steps; pressing that knob sets the depth to 0. An LFO tap opens the LFO page on the release and is played to every other mod through core_key.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
